lesson.subject: Mathematics
lesson.subtopic: Three dimensional figures: properties of cylinders and spheres, and volume

curriculum.objective: Identify the properties of cylinders and spheres
Find volume of a cube and a cuboid

objectives.objective: identify properties of cylinders and spheres
find the volume of a cube, a cuboid and a prism

references.item: New General Mathematics for Junior Secondary School book one by M.F Macrae

step.title: Step 0 — intro: activating prior knowledge
step.plan-content: Teacher recalls with the students what they have already been taught, so the work on cylinders, spheres and volume has something to stand on:

step.title: Step 1
step.plan-content: Teacher displays shapes of cylinders and spheres while the students identify the properties. Teacher draws the shapes on the board and add to the properties already mentioned by the students if there is need.

activities.activity: displays shapes of cylinders and spheres
draws the shapes on the board and adds to the properties already mentioned by the students

step.title: Step II
step.plan-content: Teacher explains how to derive the formula for volume of cube and cuboid while the students listen and ask questions where they do not understand. They copy worked examples into their notes, which also work the volume of a prism as area of base times height.

activities.activity: explains how to derive the formula for volume of cube and cuboid, and works the volume of a prism as area of base times height
listen and ask questions where they do not understand
copy worked examples into their notes

step.title: Evaluation
step.plan-content:
Teacher tests the students' understanding on the topic by giving them some questions to solve.
Question:
1. Calculate the volume of a cuboid 8cm long, 4cm wide and 3cm high. 2. Calculate the volume of cuboid with dimensions 5m by 2m by 3m. 3. What is the volume of a cube of 4cm $\times$ 4cm $\times$ 4cm. 4. A rectangular tank hold 6m long by 2m wide holds 36m$^{3}$ of water. How deep is the water in the tank.

questions.question: Calculate the volume of a cuboid 8cm long, 4cm wide and 3cm high.
Calculate the volume of cuboid with dimensions 5m by 2m by 3m.
What is the volume of a cube of 4cm $\times$ 4cm $\times$ 4cm.
A rectangular tank hold 6m long by 2m wide holds 36m$^{3}$ of water. How deep is the water in the tank.
